description: Puts out ten phasors locked to one input phasor: five slower divisions and five faster multiples

inputs.text: The phasor everything here is derived from, 0-10V
A rising edge restarts all ten output phasors at 0V

outputs.text: A slower 0-10V phasor: one cycle of it spans as many input cycles as the division marked on it
A faster 0-10V phasor: it completes as many cycles per input cycle as the multiple marked on it

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
